tool_input.command: sed -n '1,260p' src/session.js && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' README.md

/runtime/node --check src/session.js && /runtime/node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { Session } from './src/session.js'

const tick = () => Promise.resolve()
const makeHost = (queryFn) => ({ queryFn, timers: { schedule(fn) { setTimeout(fn, 0) } } })

let calls = 0
let s = new Session(makeHost(({ signal }) => { calls++; assert.equal(signal.aborted, false); return 'unexpected' }), { online: false })
let h = s.subscribe('fresh')
assert.equal(s.snapshot('fresh').fetchStatus, 'paused')
s.unsubscribe(h)
assert.deepEqual(s.snapshot('fresh'), { status: 'pending', fetchStatus: 'idle', data: null })
s.online(true)
await tick()
assert.equal(calls, 0)
h = s.subscribe('fresh')
assert.equal(calls, 1)
s.unsubscribe(h)

calls = 0
s = new Session(makeHost(() => { calls++; return 'unexpected' }), { online: false })
h = s.subscribe('queued')
s.online(true)
s.unsubscribe(h)
await tick()
assert.equal(calls, 0)
assert.equal(s.snapshot('queued').fetchStatus, 'idle')

let resolve
s = new Session(makeHost(() => new Promise(r => { resolve = r })))
h = s.subscribe('background')
assert.equal(s.snapshot('background').fetchStatus, 'fetching')
s.unsubscribe(h)
resolve('kept')
await tick()
assert.deepEqual(s.snapshot('background'), { status: 'success', fetchStatus: 'idle', data: 'kept' })

calls = 0
s = new Session(makeHost(() => { calls++; return 'refreshed' }), { online: false })
h = s.subscribe('cached', { initialData: 'old' })
s.unsubscribe(h)
s.online(true)
await tick()
assert.equal(calls, 1)
assert.deepEqual(s.snapshot('cached'), { status: 'success', fetchStatus: 'idle', data: 'refreshed' })

console.log('lifecycle assertions passed')
EOF
git diff --check && git diff -- src/session.js
